Thanks for listening to the podcast, Best in Business.
I'm sorry there was no episode last week.
I took a relaxing trip to Italy with my family and we had a wonderful time.
But it's great to be back.
And I'd like to start by welcoming today's guest, Isamu Sato.
Isamu owns one of the country's largest technology companies, which he started just five years ago.
Before today's session, I asked you to submit questions for Isamu to answer.
I'm very happy that there's so much interest in this interview, but we only have an hour.

在今天的环节之前，我请您提交问题给佐藤回答。
我很高兴这次采访有这么大的兴趣，但我们只有一小时了。
